title: Band glute bridge

steps.text: Lie on your back with the band looped just above your knees.
steps.cue: Lie on your back, band just above your knees.

steps.text: Bend your knees and set your feet flat, hip-width apart.
steps.cue: Knees bent, feet flat, hip-width apart.

steps.text: Push through your feet and lift your hips until your body makes a straight line.
steps.cue: Push through your feet. Lift your hips.

steps.text: Press your knees gently apart against the band.

mistakes: Pushing your ribs up instead of lifting from the hips.
Letting your knees fall together against the band.
regression: Do it without the band, and lift your hips only a little.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your lower back or a cramp in the back of your thigh.

anatomy.why: The buttock muscles straighten the hips, and the band makes the side of the hip hold the knees apart.
